A '''healing sheath''' was a piece of medical apparatus designed to help heal injuries. [[Hawk Carrow]] was fitted with a healing sheath aboard the [[M-Class Imperial Attack Transport]] ''[[Regina Cayli]]''. His leg had been injured by [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] who had captured him following the crash of the ''[[Dorion Discus]]'', which had been forced down by [[Imperial Office of Customs/Legends|Imperial Customs]] over [[New Bakstre]].<ref name="Regina Cayli" />
